name: exact-order-repeats-and-independent-after
source: ADR0260 Requires explicit content and plan decoder Known fields: exact strings, file order and repeats; no relationship validation
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - requires: [b, a, b, ' A ', '', deferred, 'true', '123', 2026-10-15, '$item']
    id: access
    bootstrap: true
    after: [legacy]
    owner: lead

name: after-does-not-become-requires
source: ADR0260: legacy After is retained independently, never converted

name: empty-null-and-absent
source: ADR0260 and decoder Known fields: no-item list fields are nil
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: a
    requires: []
  - id: b
    requires: null
  - id: c
    requires:
  - id: d

name: self-and-unknown-ids-are-held
source: ADR0260 separates format reading from relationship validation
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: [access, missing]

name: root-and-case-variants-are-unknown-data
source: ADR0260 Requires belongs to exact lowercase section key only; decoder unknown-field preservation
input:
schemaVersion: 1
requires: [root]
sections:
  - id: access
    Requires: [upper]
    x-requires: [extension]

name: scalar-is-not-one-item
source: Decoder list-field guards inherited by Requires under ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: setup

name: map-value-not-scanned
source: Decoder wrong-type values are not read inside; ADR0260 list guards
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: {bad: yes}

name: boolean-and-number-list-values
source: Decoder Scalars and list wrong-type guards; ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: true
  - id: other
    requires: 1

name: item-guards-and-source-order
source: Decoder Problems: every list item checked in source order with spelling before type and null as empty item; ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: [null, true, 1, yes, ~, {bad: yes}, []]

name: tags-do-not-coerce-string-items
source: Decoder Style is free and Scalars: tags ignored, quoted text preserved; ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: [!!bool 'true', !!int '123', !!str deferred]

name: tag-cannot-hide-bad-spelling
source: Decoder ignores tags and still checks plain spelling; ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: [!!str yes]

name: list-and-item-anchors
source: Decoder alias guard applies to list and item nodes; ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: &list [&item setup, *item]

name: repeated-agreeing-key
source: ADR0110 serialized keys must be unique even when matching; ADR0260 raw-key checks

name: duplicate-value-still-checked
source: Decoder duplicate-key value read normally and code order at one place; ADR0110 and ADR0260
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    requires: [a]
    requires: true

name: step-requires-is-unknown
source: ADR0260 Requires is section metadata, not step metadata; decoder unknown keys in steps
input:
schemaVersion: 1
sections:
  - id: access
    steps:
      - id: task
        requires: [setup]
